## Astroinformatics

Interactive companions to the [Astrostatistics lecture series](https://anguswright.github.io/LectureNotes/IntroductionToStatistics_materials.html).
Each page highlights one statistical principle, includes a guided experiment, and links to the relevant HTML lecture notes.

## Priority demonstrations

1. [The Universe You Don't Detect](SelectionEffects/) - selection effects and Malmquist bias.
2. [Noise Creates Massive Galaxies](EddingtonBias/) - Eddington bias.
3. [Many Noisy Stars, One Population](HierarchicalModels/) - hierarchical inference and partial pooling.
4. [Is That Spectral Line Real?](ModelEvidence/) - Bayesian model comparison.
5. [A Sky Full of False Discoveries](MultipleTesting/) - multiple testing.
6. [From Posterior Landscape to Scientific Answer](Marginalisation/) - marginalisation.
7. [Why Reliable Detectors Still Find Impostors](BaseRates/) - base rates.
8. [Knowing the Mean Is Not Predicting the Next Star](PosteriorPredictive/) - posterior prediction.

## Simulation companion

[Uncertain Encounters, Many Possible Galaxies](ForwardModelling/) - propagating uncertain inputs through a restricted tidal-encounter model; a statistical companion to the Holmberg prototype.

## Further foundations

1. [Correlations That Disappear](Correlation/) - confounding and conditioning.
2. [A Classifier under Alien Skies](SurveyShift/) - domain shift.
3. [Counting Photons](PhotonCounting/) - Poisson arrivals and Gaussian approximations.
4. [Why Stacking Works - and When It Doesn't](CentralLimit/) - the central limit theorem.
5. [Turning Uniform Randomness into a Universe](InverseSampling/) - inversion sampling.
6. [One Bad Star](RobustStatistics/) - robust statistics.
7. [Can You Trust That Bump?](DensityEstimation/) - histograms and KDEs.
